description: This file is a shell script that contains code to test how Unicode Normalization Forms (NFC and NFD) are handled on the filesystem. It defines variables representing NFC and NFD forms, performs directory creation and inspection to determine if the OS or filesystem preserves the spelling of these forms, and includes additional tests for combined and decomposed Unicode characters. The script is used for analyzing filesystem Unicode handling quirks and behaviors.
search-terms: Unicode NFC NFD filesystem testing script
